body.html: Lopburi is a town most people reach by car, or by train and then a rental car, and many in-town hotels are shophouse blocks where parking is awkward. JRD Grand Place Hotel positions itself as an in-town hotel with spacious rooms, balconies and free private parking. It sits on the New Lopburi side, in the Pa Tan sub-district, close to the city centre and restaurants — an area that's easy for food and errands. That suits travellers who drive and want a stay that's simple to pull into, without squeezing into the crowded old-town quarter.

The hotel opened around 2015 with about 45 rooms. There's a range — from Standard Double and Twin rooms up to Superior/Deluxe rooms that are larger, many of which open onto a balcony. Reviewers most often praise the spacious, clean rooms, the comfortably soft beds and the quiet that makes for an easy night's sleep. Rooms come with air-con, satellite TV, drinking water and a shower. The overall feel is simple and tidy, geared to comfort at a budget price rather than fancy styling.
"Spacious, clean room, nicely soft bed, quiet and easy for sleeping. Smiling, helpful staff at the counter, easy parking. Good value for Lopburi."

What makes JRD Grand Place work for drivers is free private parking and a location close to the centre. There's free Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant, a meeting room, a 24-hour front desk and laundry. Breakfast is a simple offering — rice soup, fried rice, fruit and toast. The thing to know is that there's no swimming pool, and breakfast is limited and can run out on busier mornings — it's a comfortable in-town place to sleep rather than a resort to spend all day in. But because it's close to the centre and restaurants, heading out for breakfast is no trouble.

The location is in New Lopburi, on the Pa Tan side, close to the city centre. The main old-town sights — Phra Prang Sam Yod, the San Phra Kan Shrine and King Narai's Palace — are about a 10–12 minute drive. There are convenience stores, restaurants and cafes to walk to nearby. The thing to know is that street-facing rooms can pick up some traffic noise at times; if you're a light sleeper, ask for an inner room, which is quieter. This location is about car convenience and being near the centre, not walkable old-town sightseeing.

On scores, JRD Grand Place rates well for a budget in-town Lopburi stay. The average from real guest reviews sits around 8.3 out of 10, though the review count is still modest, so platform scores can swing. Recurring praise covers spacious, clean rooms, comfortably soft beds, the quiet, smiling and helpful staff and easy parking. The common gripes: some fittings and facilities look a little dated, breakfast is limited and can run out, and street-facing rooms get some traffic noise.

Honestly, JRD Grand Place is one of Lopburi's value in-town hotels, and its appeal is in spacious rooms, balconies, free parking and a central location rather than design or full resort facilities. If your trip is a short self-drive around Lopburi, or you're in town on business, you want a comfortable in-town room with parking, and you don't mind skipping the pool — it fits and the price is fair. If you want a stay with a pool, a fuller breakfast, or newer fittings, look at the other options in this round-up.

A tip from reading plenty of reviews here: if you want a balcony, say so when booking, and if you sleep lightly, ask for an inner room away from the road, which is quieter. Breakfast is limited and can run out, so go down a little early to get the full spread, or head out to a restaurant in town. There's free parking, so use it as a base to drive around Lopburi. And because the location is in New Lopburi, keep a ride-hailing app ready for getting in to see the monkeys and old temples in the old-town quarter if you don't have a car.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Standard rooms start at around ฿660/night in normal periods. There's a range — Standard Double and Twin, plus Superior and Deluxe rooms that are larger, many with a balcony. Rooms have air-con, satellite TV and drinking water. Prices vary by season and holidays, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Is there a pool and breakfast?

There's free Wi-Fi, free private parking, an on-site restaurant, a meeting room, a 24-hour front desk and laundry. It's best for self-drivers or business travellers who want a spacious, comfortable in-town Lopburi room at a budget price.
